title: Northport partnership seed riff
content:
Context:
Quick personal scratch for a targeted pilot ask to Northport (regional retail chain, ~120 stores). Goal = get an intro call with Head of Product / Head of Ops to pitch a 6-week pilot: in-store customer support + returns-categorization + POS assistant.

What I know (public + signals):
- Recent Series B early 2025, expanding east coast footprint.
- Press: pilot with IoT checkout in Q2 (store-level experiments).
- Tech org small-ish, product leader: Dana Mercer (VP Product) mentioned on podcast about reducing call center load.
- Likely constraints: PII in transcripts, low tolerance for model hallucinations, cost sensitivity.

Value-mapping (how Redwood helps):
- Hosted API for quick PoC with streaming chat to demo live cashier assistant.
- Dedicated or Private offering if they want data isolation for PII / PCI concerns (private VPC + KMS).
- Caching + batching => reduce token costs for repetitive SKU lookup queries.
- Rollouts + canary = safe incrementally deploy assistant to 1 store.

Outbound sketch (sequence):
1) Cold email subject line options (test A/B):
   A: "Northport + Redwood: 6-week in-store AI pilot to cut call volume"
   B: "Can we reduce Northport returns handling time by 30%?"
2) Short opener (20–40 words):
   "Hey Dana — quick note: we helped a regional retailer cut returns triage time by 28% using a small LLM assistant + ruleset. Would you be open to a 20-min pilot design call to see if we can replicate for Northport stores?"
3) Follow ups: stats-led, customer quote, ask for 20-min slot.

Key asks for intro call:
- Current return volumes and top 3 return reasons (estimate).
- Existing transcript / chat volume (call center).
- Data residency / compliance must-haves.
- Success metric: minutes per return triage, CSAT, cost per call.

Objections + rebuttals (practical):
- "We can't send PII to third party" -> offer Private deployment + KMS + processing within VPC; can sign SOC2 + addendum; demo anonymization pipeline.
- "Models hallucinate" -> show guardrails: structured outputs, schema enforcement, reranking, evals tied to prompt sets; mention Redwood Optimize suggestions and quality monitoring alerts.
- "Too expensive" -> show batching/caching examples, quantization recommendations, and a scoped pilot focused on high-value return categories only.

Experiment ideas (A/B):
- Email subject A vs B above.
- Demo: live cashier script vs recorded transcript replay—which resonates with Ops?
- Pilot scope: returns triage vs cashier assist (start with returns, easier metric).

Meeting prep checklist (if we get a call):
- 1-pager tailored to returns workflow + sample transcripts (anonymized).
- Rough SOW for 6-week pilot (milestones, data access, success metrics, rollback plan).
- Internal SME: Marco (solutions) + Evelyn (security) on standby.

Next steps (action items):
- Draft initial cold email and sequence (ASAP) — Asha to write, Marco to review by 2025-10-16.
- Pull 1 anonymized transcript sample to include in follow-up (ask data team for redaction guide).
- Create short slide: "Northport returns pilot — 6-week plan" (2 slides + demo link).

Open questions / unknowns to resolve:
- Exact title/contact for Head of Ops — is it "VP Store Ops" or "Head of Field Operations"? LinkedIn search pending.
- Are there existing vendor relationships for conversational AI in pilot stores? (If yes, ask about contract length and exit clauses.)

Quick pitch script (20-min call):
- 0–3m: intros + why we reached out (data point about reducing calls)
- 3–8m: problems we see in returns/cashier flows + live mini-demo (replay transcript)
- 8–12m: propose pilot scope + success metrics + security posture (Private option)
- 12–18m: operational questions + timeline (can we get data in 2 weeks?)
- 18–20m: clear next step = pilot SOW + mutual NDA or security questionnaire.

Notes to self (messy):
- Keep ask small: 1 store or set of tills + sample transcripts.
- Emphasize observability (Console dashboards) — PMs like metrics.
- If we don't hear back after 2 follow-ups, try connecting via mutual (Dana -> ex-boss contact) or Slack if public workspace.

End of scratch.
